messages:
maya: Prod US-WEST hosted-api - queue length shot up and a bunch of GPU nodes got ejected. paging @ops-oncall. seeing large number of admission rejects and region fallback.
sam: On it. Any recent deploys or config changes?
maya: No code deploys in the last 3h. I did bump autoscaler min replicas for the gpu pool this morning (small change). Also partner embedding job started around 14:20 UTC.
ops-oncall: I'm seeing admission controller decline rate increase at 14:33 UTC. p50 latency up a little, p99 -> 1.8s. queue depth: 12k -> 41k in 7m.
infra-sre: logs snippet:
```
[2027-09-01T14:32:58Z] pool-manager(us-west-gpu): accept_rate=0.92 headroom=0.05
[2027-09-01T14:33:02Z] admission-controller: reject new sessions pool=us-west-gpu reason=admission_capacity
[2027-09-01T14:33:07Z] node-health: mark gpu-az3-07 UNHEALTHY reason=oom-eject
[2027-09-01T14:33:09Z] router: fallback routing enabled -> dedicated-pool-us-east
[2027-09-01T14:33:12Z] dedicated-pool-us-east: enqueue_depth surge -> admission_hard_limit
```
infra-sre: Note: eviction here is not full OOMs across the node; we saw unbounded KV cache rebuilds leading to memory pressure and the node manager's ejection heuristic kicked in.
deploy-bot: No deploys in last 3h. Autoscaler config change by maya at 09:12 UTC: `min_replicas: 10 -> 20`.
lauren: The partner embedding flow that started was a short burst: ~180k small-embed requests over 8m (spiky, high concurrency). We set it to use hosted-us-west ephemeral routing.
billing: Cost watch: cross-region hop to dedicated-pool-us-east triggered large GPU-hours and inter-region egress; rough cost delta +$18k for the hour so far.
ops-oncall: Immediate mitigation: disable cross-region fallback and enforce strict local admission cap. Patching admission policy now.
ops-oncall: command run:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-config/api/admission -d '{"fallback_policy":"strict","cross_region_fallback":false}'
```
infra-sre: Also temporarily increased admission headroom from 0.05->0.20 to avoid ejection cascade while we stabilize. Patch applied to pool config.
maya: I've paused the partner embed job at source. Partner notified.
sam: After the patch, queue depth trending down to 6k, p99 ~ 900ms and nodes not being ejected further. Monitoring.
ops-oncall: Next steps (short):
- run a root-cause investigation on KV cache rebuild behavior and why autoscaler change amplified pressure
- add a circuit-breaker to prevent cross-region fallback from routing >5% traffic without manual approval
- revisit ejection heuristic threshold for memory pressure to prefer throttling requests over ejecting nodes

infra-sre: Action items assigned:
- lauren -> provide exact request pattern from partner (keys per request, median token lengths)
- maya -> provide autoscaler diff and rationale + revert sequence
- sam -> produce timeline of admission events and routing handoffs
- ops-oncall -> temporary policy tweaks and rollback plan

lauren: will post partner request log and sample rate curves in this thread in a minute.
maya: putting postmortem doc stub in /docs/incidents/1790034567-gpu-ejection-rush.md when we have initial RCA. short-term fixes done, moving to mitigation->postmortem phase. :white_check_mark:
